summary: JCPS opposes proposals to sunset E-Rate program as it is an ongoing operational necessity with continuous lifecycle upgrades and bandwidth scaling requirements. The comment argues against limiting or sunsetting E-Rate, emphasizing the need to maintain funding for broadband infrastructure and connectivity in schools. The FCC comment argues against limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing its importance for funding broadband infrastructure and maintaining educational access. The school district urges the FCC to preserve current E-Rate funding and reject any screen-time mandates as a condition of receiving support.

claims.argument: E-Rate is an ongoing operational necessity requiring continuous lifecycle upgrades and bandwidth scaling
claims.evidence_quote: Connectivity is an ongoing operational necessity requiring continuous lifecycle upgrades and bandwidth scaling.

claims.requested_action: Preserve and protect the current E-Rate funding cap
claims.argument: The funding cap would be absolutely devastating to operational capacity
claims.evidence_quote: Rate funding—especially when tied to unworkable, top-down federal "screen-time" mandates—would be absolutely devastating to our operational capacity and the educational outcomes of our nearly 100,000 students.
